rows.Origin:
Bred by NIRP International (France, before 2007).
Introduced in France by NIRP International / Lux Riviera in 2007 as 'Magdalena'.
rows.Bloom: Orange, peach reverse, light pink outer petals. Mild fragrance. up to 35 petals. Average diameter 3.25". Medium to large, full (26-40 petals), borne mostly solitary bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for cut flower.
